Welcome to AIMI LAB!

Yixing Huang

Huang Yixing is currently an Assistant Professor and Full Research Professor at the Institute of Medical Technology, Peking University Health Science Center. He received his Bachelor’s degree from Peking University in 2013, and his Master’s and Doctoral degrees from Friedrich-Alexander-University Erlangen-Nuremberg in Germany in 2016 and 2020, respectively. His research primarily focuses on cone-beam CT reconstruction and image analysis, as well as medical image analysis in tumor radiotherapy, including limited-angle reconstruction, field-of-view extension, MRI brain metastasis detection and segmentation, large language model-assisted decision-making, and survival prediction for cancer patients. To date, he has published over 50 academic papers and holds 3 patents, with 30 journal and conference papers as first author or corresponding author, including top medical imaging journals TMI and MedIA, top conference MICCAI, and the Red Journal and Green Journal of radiation oncology. He leads the National Natural Science Foundation of China Excellent Young Scientists Fund (Overseas), the National Natural Science Foundation of China General Program, the Capital Health Development Research Special Youth Key Research Project, and the Beijing Natural Science Foundation Joint Fund Cultivation Project. He is a doctoral supervisor and a recipient of the 2024 Excellent Young Scientists Fund (Overseas).

黄益星

黄益星，现任北京大学医学部医学技术研究院助理教授/研究员，博士生导师，2024年海外优秀青年基金获得者。2013年获北京大学学士学位，2016年和2020年分别获德国埃尔朗根-纽伦堡大学硕士和博士学位。主要从事锥形束CT重建和影像分析以及肿瘤放疗中的医学影像分析，包括有限角度重建、视野扩增、MRI脑转移瘤检测分割、大语言模型决策辅助、肿瘤病人生存率预测等。目前共发表50余篇学术论文和专利3项，其中以一作和通讯发表期刊会议30篇，包括医学影像顶刊TMI和MedIA、顶会MICCAI、肿瘤放疗红皮和绿皮期刊。主持国家自然科学基金优秀青年科学基金项目（海外）、国家自然科学基金面上项目、首都卫生发展科研专项青年重点攻关项目、北京市自然科学基金联合基金培育项目。

Biography

Ao Wang is a Ph.D. student in Medical Technology at the Institute of Medical Technology, Peking University Health Science Center, and a member of the AIMI Lab. His research focuses on CT image reconstruction and computational imaging, with particular interests in quantum CT, QUBO models, neural radiance fields, and computed laminography. Before joining Peking University, he received his B.Eng. degree from North China University of Water Resources and Electric Power and his M.Eng. degree from Chongqing University.

Meng Li is currently a Postdoctoral Fellow at the Institute of Medical Technology, Peking University Health Science Center, working under the supervision of Dr. Yixing Huang. She obtained her Ph.D. through the joint doctoral program between Northeastern University and the University of Pennsylvania. Her research primarily focuses on developing multimodal MRI-based methodologies to assess brain pathologies and identify potential biomarkers associated with neuropsychiatric disorders. She has conducted some innovative research in the field of brain science and published a number of peer-reviewed works.

Haijun Yu

Haijun Yu is a Boya Postdoctoral Fellow at the Institute of Medical Technology, Peking University Health Science Center, with his collaborating supervisor being Asst. Prof. Yixing Huang. He obtained his doctoral degree from Chongqing University in September 2024. He conducted research as a joint-training doctoral student at Friedrich-Alexander-Universität Erlangen-Nürnberg, Germany in 2023 under the sponsorship of the China Scholarship Council (CSC). His main research areas include linear CT technology and systems, intelligent CT image reconstruction and analysis. He has published 35 academic papers with 13 as first/corresponding author in SCI journals such as Applied Mathematical Modelling, IEEE Transactions on Instrumentation and Measurement, IEEE Transactions on Radiation and Plasma Medical Sciences, Signal Processing, Optics Express.

en.title: AIMI
en.html: The Artificial Intelligence for Medical Imaging (AIMI) Lab at the Institute of Medical Technology, Peking University Health Science Center, has been newly established. The lab is dedicated to advancing both fundamental research and clinical translation of artificial intelligence in medical imaging, with a strong focus on precision medicine. Its research areas include CT image reconstruction, MRI-based tumor segmentation, image-guided radiation oncology, patient prognosis and survival analysis, digital pathology, and computer-vision-driven medical image generation. AIMI strives to develop cutting-edge intelligent imaging technologies to support disease diagnosis, treatment planning, and therapy assessment.

zh.title: AIMI 智能医学影像实验室
zh.html: 北京大学医学部医学技术研究院智能医学影像实验室（Artificial Intelligence for Medical Imaging, AIMI）近日正式成立。课题组聚焦人工智能在医学影像领域的基础研究与临床转化应用，面向精准医学的发展需求，重点开展 CT 图像重建、MRI 肿瘤自动分割、图像引导肿瘤放疗、患者预后与生存分析、数字病理、机器视觉驱动的医学图像生成等方向的研究。实验室致力于推进智能影像技术的发展，为疾病诊断、治疗决策与疗效评估提供创新性的技术支撑。
